Original 32³ R8 and RGBA8 noise volumes in uncompressed KTX2.
Use linear filtering and repeat wrapping. Regenerate with `python3 generate-noise.py`.
These serve the same purpose as Shadertoy noise inputs; voxel values are original.
Demo shaders live under `glsl/volume-input`, `slang/volume-input`, and `wgsl/volume-input`.
